name: Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off14
signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off14(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
summary: Reads the low byte of the tag-1 field on the +0x14 sub-table via 0x00661534, returning 0 when absent; feeds a voice param byte in Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase.
evidence: Single named caller Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase; body masks &0xff of the fetched field; consistent with the documented voice-param use.

name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off14
signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off14(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
summary: Reads the high byte of the tag-1 field on the +0x14 sub-table via 0x00661534, returning 0 when absent; used by six sound sequence routines.
evidence: Six named sound callers (GetVoiceParamsBase, ReadDescriptorA/B, FindEventOffset, GetTrackChannelBase, GetTrackKindBase); body shifts >>8 of the fetched field.

name: Sound_SeqField_GetFlagBit0_Off14
signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqField_GetFlagBit0_Off14(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
summary: Reads the tag-0x11 field on the +0x14 sub-table and returns bit 0 as a boolean flag, or 0 when absent; feeds a voice param byte in Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase.
evidence: Single named caller Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase; body masks &1 of the fetched field, a clear boolean extraction.

name: Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off14B
signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqField_GetByteHi_Off14B(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
summary: Reads the high byte of the tag-2 field on the +0x14 sub-table via 0x00661534, returning 0 when absent; feeds a voice param word in Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase.
evidence: Two named callers (GetVoiceParamsBase, GetTrackChannelBase); body shifts >>8 of the fetched tag-2 field.

name: Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off14B
signature: unsigned int Sound_SeqField_GetByte_Off14B(SoundSeqRecord* record, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int* arg3, unsigned int index)
summary: Reads the byte of the tag-2 field on the +0x14 sub-table, defaulting to 0x40 when absent; feeds a voice param word in Sound_Seq_GetVoiceParamsBase.
evidence: Six named sound callers including Sound_Voice_ConfigureDspChannels and Sound_Voice_SetVolumeDirect; body masks &0xff with 0x40 fallback.

name: Sound_WaveInfo_GetSubBlockPair
signature: bool Sound_WaveInfo_GetSubBlockPair(SoundParamOwner* owner, void* outBlock, void* outPointer, unsigned int index)
summary: Fetches a 0x26-byte sub-block from the sound parameter object into outBlock and the following pointer into outPointer, returning true if found.
evidence: Eight named sound callers (wave cache, bank, stream, voice); body memcpy of 0x26 bytes plus pointer copy; twin of 0x006614E4.

name: Sound_Seq_GetTrackOffsetBase
signature: u32 Sound_Seq_GetTrackOffsetBase(SoundSeqData* self)
summary: Base timestamp query: resolves the record through 0x0065F678 and tail-jumps into Sound_SeqField_GetInt_Off14, returning the record's +0x14 integer (0xFFFFFFFF when absent).
evidence: Single caller maybe_Sound_SeqParam_ApplyTimestamp treats result as a 64-bit track offset; disassembly shows tail jump into Sound_SeqField_GetInt_Off14.

name: Sound_WaveInfo_GetSubBlockPairAlt
signature: bool Sound_WaveInfo_GetSubBlockPairAlt(SoundParamOwner* owner, void* outBlock, void* outPointer, unsigned int index)
summary: Byte-identical twin of 0x0066092C: copies a 0x26-byte sub-block from the sound parameter object into outBlock and the following pointer into outPointer.
evidence: 42 callers (30 named) across voice, track dispatch and wave-info routines; identical body to 0x0066092C.

name: maybe_Ui_Element_GetMetricA
signature: float maybe_Ui_Element_GetMetricA(UiElementHolder* holder)
summary: Calls virtual slot +0x14 of the interface at holder+0x24 and converts the integer result to float. The only caller is an xref artifact, so the meaning of the metric is unknown.
evidence: Pure virtual getter wrapper; single caller Math_Matrix44_Multiply is an xref artifact; no strings or constants.

name: maybe_Ui_Element_GetScaledHeight
signature: float maybe_Ui_Element_GetScaledHeight(UiElementHolder* self)
summary: Calls virtual slot +0x10 of the interface at self+0x24 and converts the result to float; the caller uses it as a rect height, but the 'scaled' part is not visible in the body.
evidence: Body only calls slot +0x10 and converts to float; no multiply by self+0x0C appears in the decompiled body despite the doc claim.

name: maybe_Field_Object2D_IsPointInAreaRect
signature: u32 maybe_Field_Object2D_IsPointInAreaRect(void* self, unsigned int direction)

evidence: Rectangle bounds from +0x2BC/+0x2C0 and record u16 fields +0x10..+0x16, point at +0x78/+0x7C shifted by ±2; caller Field2D_MapChip_TestCellWalkable.

name: Field2D_Scene_GetStyleByte15

name: Field2D_Layer_GetField12B

name: maybe_MoLive_Stream_ReadPcm
signature: int maybe_MoLive_Stream_ReadPcm(MoLiveStream* self, u32* out, u32 outWords)

evidence: Damaged decompilation with halt_baddata and trampolines; caller MoLive_Decoder_GetPacket; ring fields f_30/f_34/f_3C/f_54/f_58/f_5C/f_60.

name: maybe_Ui_Object_DestroyWithInlineThread
signature: void maybe_Ui_Object_DestroyWithInlineThread(void* self, void* owner)
summary: Stores owner pointers, destroys the inline thread object at self+0xE0F8, then tail-calls the object's virtual destructor; the leading stores are unexplained.

name: maybe_Field2D_Map_DetachOverlay
signature: void maybe_Field2D_Map_DetachOverlay(void* self, u32 arg2, u32 object, int apply)

name: maybe_std_ModfBlockA
signature: void maybe_std_ModfBlockA(void)
summary: Not a real function: an unaligned 4-byte artefact inside the ARM std_Modf exponent<0 branch; the decompiled body is a bogus byte-swap stub.

name: maybe_Text_NormalizeKanaName
